notes.title: Mini-update and future plans
notes.content:
[h1]Update Contents[/h1]

[h2]Blue weapon, function fixed[/h2]
The specification of guns that move the position of objects has been changed.
It has been fixed so that objects cannot be brought to the other side of walls.
As a result of this fix, the shortcuts that used to work will no longer work.
Time attack ranking has been newly established as Early Access 3rd.

We will reconsider this if there are many people who think it is too difficult to play because it limits the degree of freedom.


[h2]Changes to the tutorial stage[/h2]
We modified the tutorial stage to make it a little easier to understand.
The stage has been modified to make it a little easier to understand.


[h2]Changes to the menu screen[/h2]
The menu screen has been redesigned.


[h2]Some camera shaking has been removed.[/h2]
There were stages where the camera would move slightly depending on the character's position.
This was causing some stress, so we removed the unnecessary camera work.



[h2]Future plans[/h2]
Our goal was to officially release the game in December.
However, we have received several suggestions for improvement, and in order to make solid improvements
However, as we have received several suggestions for improvements, we have decided that in order to make solid improvements, we need to make major changes to the stage content from the current stage.

Although it is difficult to release it officially at an early date, we would like to make it official by the end of 2022.

Also, we're considering changing the rules for the replacements.
We hope that people who have already completed the game will be able to enjoy it again.

The stage you can play now will be a different stage in the next update.

Thank you for reading to the end.

We hope you will continue to send us your suggestions for improvement.

notes.title: Gamepad is now officially supported.
notes.content:
Gamepad operation had been available for some time, but it was very difficult to move the cursor while jumping, so it was deprecated.
With this update, we have made some major changes, especially in the jumping process, so that you can now play with gamepads.
The jumping may be a little bit unique, so we'd be happy to hear your feedback after you try it out.

[h2]Major changes Jump behavior[/h2]

The previous control method was to fall slowly while holding down the jump button.

Now, when you jump and fall, the game will fall slowly even if you don't hold down the jump button.

If you press the down key or the jump key while falling, the game will return to normal falling speed.

As long as you hold down the jump key, the fall will remain slow even if you press down.

This change will make it easier to play if you are not good at holding down the jump key.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The orange parabola shot used to have a separate button for charging, but you can now charge it by holding down the normal shot button. This change was made to improve the gamepad operation.
[*] The key layout of the gamepad has been slightly changed. The key layout on the gamepad has changed slightly, such as the ability to jump with the left trigger L2.
[*] The purple reflection shot used to be that you couldn't fire another shot until the bullet disappeared, but now you can fire up to three.
[*] The predictive line of the purple reflection shot has been adjusted to make it easier to see.
[*] The number of restarts can now be checked in the pause menu.
[*] The side-by-side display of weapon selection has been removed and is now only in ring command format.
[*] Added some hints for the bosses.
[*] Re-adjusted the gimmick of the stage before the boss room.
[/list]

[h2]Recent Mini Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] 9/24 In-game key configuration function added.
[*] 9/14 Steam Cloud support.
[*] 8/28 It is now possible to change the movement speed of the aiming cursor.
[*] 8/26 Camera bug fixed.
[*] 8/24 Changed Time Attack entrance to be from the start.
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

We hope to officially release the game in December, after we've resolved some of the improvements we've received and the bugs we haven't yet resolved.

Thanks to all the feedback and the play videos, the game has been improved a lot. Thank you very much.

We hope to have your feedback and suggestions in the community.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1667160/discussions/

Thank you for reading to the end.
I will try my best to make you want to play the game again.

notes.title: 9/24 Mini Update: Key Config Added
notes.content:
Until now, we've been showing you how to change the key configuration via Steam's features.
With today's update, you can now change the key layout within the game's option settings.

It took a while to implement, but I think the good thing is that you can change the jumping process on the gamepad to your preferred settings.

In the next update, I'll make the gamepad officially supported.

In order to play the game comfortably with a gamepad, we've decided that we need to readjust the gravity and jump processing.
This may change the feel of the game a bit. We would like to make adjustments so that you will feel that we have made improvements.

Thank you for reading to the end.
We will continue to work on updates and improvements.
